response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, `aCL IgM`, `aCL IgM` - (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM linked) AS deviation FROM linked), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.`aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.average_deviation AS above_sex_average FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.average_deviation ORDER BY above_sex_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
